chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man in his mid-20s with a short black buzz cut and a thin beard, wearing a faded mustard-yellow hoodie and grey sweatpants
chars.LIAR: a skinny young Moroccan man with a curly black mullet and a thin moustache, wearing a red-and-white horizontally striped football jersey
chars.FRIEND: a bald stocky Moroccan man in his 30s with a thick black beard, wearing a dark green tracksuit jacket
chars.OLDMAN: an older Moroccan prisoner with grey stubble and a white knitted skullcap, wearing a brown wool djellaba

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a crowded, worn Moroccan prison cell with blankets on the floor and a small barred window. NARRATOR stands in the doorway glaring with fury at LIAR, who sits on a floor mattress looking back nervously and defensively. Open tension between the two, other prisoners watching in the background.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan prison cell. Several prisoners smirk and point at LIAR's thin floor mattress, which is soaked and stained with sticky jam and spilled sugar. LIAR stands beside it, shocked and humiliated, arms open.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close view of a thin floor mattress and a grey blanket in a dim Moroccan prison cell, a long trail of black ants marching onto the sticky stain on the mattress. Gritty, unsettling mood.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan prison cell. NARRATOR sits on the edge of a top bunk, fists clenched, jaw tight, eyes burning with anger, staring across the room at LIAR who avoids his gaze in a corner.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Prison yard corner by a concrete wall in Morocco. OLDMAN secretly slips a small folded razor blade into NARRATOR's palm, both glancing around suspiciously, hushed secretive deal.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR walks into a Moroccan prison cell; all the prisoners lying on blankets on the floor go silent and stare at him without moving, heavy tense silence, dim yellow ceiling light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night in a dark Moroccan prison cell lit only by faint blue moonlight through the barred window. NARRATOR lies awake on the top bunk, eyes wide open, face half in shadow with a dark, vengeful expression, sleeping prisoners below.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, dark Moroccan prison cell in blue moonlight. NARRATOR quietly climbs down from the top bunk and crouches over LIAR, who is asleep on a floor mattress, holding a tiny razor blade near LIAR's face. Extremely tense, no blood.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Night, dark Moroccan prison cell in blue moonlight. FRIEND suddenly wakes up on his mattress, propped on one elbow, reaching out alarmed toward NARRATOR who freezes crouched above the sleeping LIAR. Shock and suspense, no blood.
